items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: Eighty-four is specified as a numerical count.
Thousands are specified as the measure of those locations.
Womb-diagrams are specified as the locations in question.
Those present in those locations are specified as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified.
The nature or duration of the torment remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
